Granite Flat Markers

PCM Design Catalog

Every flat-marker and ledger design Pacific Coast Memorials makes, plus the full ornament library — in two sections, one for a marker with one name and one for a marker with two, each grouped by what the design shows. The design number is on every card so a family can point and we can look it up on the spot.
829 single · 489 companion designs · 619 full-colour proofs · 699 book plates · 3,973 design elements · 28 photographed markers
e.g. 1183, PCM 728, BASS 001
Single Marker Designs Companion Designs Design Elements Installed Examples Sizes, Colors & Lettering
Single Marker Designs
Every design here is for a marker with one name. The 457 black and white plates further down are scans of the design books, grouped by what they show. Pricing isn’t shown here; I build the quote in the tool.
These are Pacific Coast Memorials’ own full-colour proofs: the design printed on the granite colour with sample lettering, instead of the black and white plate the design books use. They’re the clearest pictures I have of these 372 one-name designs, so I put them first. 161 of these numbers aren’t printed in either design book. Search by what you’re looking for, and the tags under each card show why it came back.

Companion Designs
Every design here is for a marker with two names — one stone across two spaces. Same arrangement as above: the proofs first, then the 242 book plates by theme.
The same full-colour proofs for 247 designs made for a marker with two names. They carry the same PCM numbers as the design books, so the Go to # box finds them and typing companion reaches all of them. 128 of these numbers aren’t printed in either design book.
Cross, candles and roses
PCM 245
An upright stone with a cross and lit candles inside a sunburst, roses spreading either side above the name panels.
format: companioncrosscandlerosereligiousflower
Tractor and treeline
PCM 258
An upright stone with a treeline and birds above the name panels and an old tractor pulling a plow across the field below.
format: companiontractorfarmingfarmfieldtreebird
Two birds on a pine branch
PCM 2100
A pair of small birds perched on a pine branch between the two name panels, with an oval photo at each upper corner.
format: companionbirdpinebranchportrait
Sailboat in a rope border
PCM 2101
A sailboat under full sail centered in a rope-edged panel, with an oval photo at each upper corner.
format: companionsailboatsailingnauticalropeborderportrait
Oval panel with flowers
PCM 2102
A large oval panel holding both names, with a spray of flowers and leaves swept along the bottom edge and an oval photo at each side.
format: companionovalflowerfloral sprayleavesportrait
Eagle over a river valley
PCM 2103
An eagle soaring above a river winding through mountains, with the moon low on the horizon behind.
format: companioneaglebirdrivermountainlandscapemoon
Hammock under palm trees
PCM 2106
A hammock strung between palm trees on a tropical shore, with a small cross set between the two first names.
format: companionpalmtropicalcrossbeachlandscape
Movie projector and film
PCM 2107
A film projector and reels with a strip of film curling across the bottom carrying a short banner line.
format: companionmoviefilmbannerhobby
Wedding rings and flowers
PCM 2108
An arched banner carries the family name with flowers at both ends, and two interlocked wedding rings sit between the name panels.
format: companionringsweddingbannerflowerscroll
Mountain lake and forest
PCM 2109
A mountain reflected in a still lake with forest along both shores, filling the panel under the two names.
format: companionmountainlakeforestlandscapeportrait
Framed name with corner flowers
PCM 2110
A raised name plate inside a full border, with flowers and leaves worked into each of the four corners.
format: companionborderflowerleavesornamentmorning glory
Daffodils down the side
PCM 2111
Tall daffodils on long stems run up the left side of the marker beside the name panel.
format: companiondaffodilflower
Eagle and a colour sunset
PCM 2113
An eagle gliding with wings spread, with a small full-colour sunset over water set in an oval beside it.
format: companioneaglebirdsunsetoceanoval
Shoreline with gulls
PCM 2114
A tall tree at the left and gulls over open water, with a rocky shoreline running under the two name panels.
format: companiontreeoceanbeachseagullbirdlandscape
Eagle landing with roses
PCM 2115
An eagle coming in to land with wings up, roses beneath its talons, set beside the raised family name.
format: companioneaglebirdroseflower
Cross with irises
PCM 2118
A raised cross at the centre with iris blooms and long leaves growing up around its base.
format: companioncrossflowerreligiousleaves
Garden gate and mountain
PCM 2120
An open garden gate on a stone path with trees and a mountain beyond, and a small married-date plaque at the base.
format: companiongategardenmountaintreelandscapewedding
Windswept tree
PCM 2121
A single windswept tree on a low mound fills the left half of the panel beside the two names.
format: companiontreeasian
Open books and a heart
PCM 2122
Each name sits on an open book, with a small heart and flowers between them and an oval photo above.
format: companionbookbooksheartflowerportraitcouple
Fishing from a boat
